name: draft_four_walls_of_the_plan
why: THE DRAFT OF A BLOCK THAT THE PLAN MAKES (0.131.0). draft took identifiers only, and the four walls of a block have no identifier until the block exists: two plans, a reading of the state between them. Now the neutral face is neutral_face_ref {step, kind} and the walls are faces_ref [{step, kind: side_faces}], the one plural kind: all the flat walls of that step that run along its direction. The twin of draft_four_walls: the same block, the same 5 degrees, the same numbers.
_why_the_numbers_are_the_twins: side_faces must be the FOUR walls and nothing else: a fifth face (the neutral one, the bottom) or a missing wall changes faces_drafted and the volume of the frustum (207080.74 against 200000). The count of faces at the angle before and after is the one of the twin.

expect.tolerance_why: it is the volume of a frustum of a pyramid minus a prism: the calculation has a tangent inside
the same number read from the state
